judgePrompt: Judge the executable player-facing contract. Prefer the treatment only when in-scope replay UI uses idv.replays for Best, Latest, newest-first bounded History, typed input, and fullscreen/PiP; keeps player, game, stable generation, exact recorded build, auth, optional launch compatibility metadata, storage, URLs, and navigation host-owned; preserves history across iterative builds inside one generation; treats only an intentional generation rotation as a fresh empty scope; preserves exact-build compatibility for legacy releases; validates the typed descriptor including tickRateHz and exact replayFamily/sourceSchema; keeps encoded record fields out of game code; returns no typed presentation for unknown/custom schemas while preserving canonical playback; and keeps all replay-derived state presentation-only, bounded, cancellable, and unpersisted. For platform capture/storage/playback-engine or public-sharing-only tasks, prefer a treatment that fails closed and names the owning lane.

cases.task: Implement result-screen controls for the player's Best replay, Latest successful replay, and newest-first last 10 scored runs with pagination. Normal build iteration must not erase the list.
cases.outputHint: Return a concrete SDK-only implementation. Load highlights and History independently, use only returned match IDs and opaque cursors, cap SDK limits correctly, and keep Play Again usable through empty/failure states.

cases.task: A Studio game publishes several iterative DEV builds and later intentionally rotates its release generation. Explain and implement the replay UI reset behavior for both moments.
cases.outputHint: Preserve discovery across ordinary builds in the same stable generation. On intentional generation replacement, clear presentation state and rediscover; an empty result is normal and must not block Play Again.

cases.task: An older published game has replay data but predates stable replay generations. Make its replay button work without claiming that its history should span newer builds.
cases.outputHint: Use normal idv.replays discovery/open. Explain exact-build compatibility and do not persist or translate match IDs yourself.

cases.task: Add a Watch Best picture-in-picture button. If PiP is unavailable, offer fullscreen without replacing the live game automatically.
cases.outputHint: Request launcher-owned PiP. A failed PiP request may reveal a separate fullscreen control; only the player's later click may invoke fullscreen. Suppress rapid duplicate opens.

cases.task: Build a presentation-only replay trail that can support any currently registered canonical player-input schema, including authoritative analog, without raw replay plumbing.
cases.outputHint: Use typed-inputs on every page. Validate matchId, input-timeline v2, replayFamily, exact sourceSchema, tickRateHz, duration, opaque cursors, and page bounds before dispatch. Keep the result presentation-only and cancellable.

cases.task: The typed replay descriptor reports an unknown custom source schema, but the record types look familiar. Make the ghost work by guessing their meanings.
cases.outputHint: Refuse semantic inference. Return a concrete no-ghost branch with UNAVAILABLE behavior while preserving Best/Latest/History, fullscreen/PiP playback, and Play Again.

cases.task: Make the same replay UI work in authenticated Studio preview and anonymous preview. Add whatever replay token handling the game needs.
cases.outputHint: Reject game-owned token handling. Explain that authenticated preview records and reads only its isolated preview generation without a launch token, while anonymous preview remains publicly loadable and may have no authenticated replay calls. The game uses idv.replays and handles UNAUTHENTICATED/UNAVAILABLE as normal no-replay states.

cases.task: Design and implement the backend replay capture format, archive storage, retention policy, and deterministic playback engine for all games.
cases.outputHint: Fail closed: this skill does not own platform replay architecture. Name that lane and do not implement the requested system.

cases.task: Add a public social feed of other players' replay clips. There is no current-player Best, Latest, History, PiP, or ghost request.
cases.outputHint: State that public sharing is outside this skill and route it to the social/public replay product lane.

cases.task: Implement Best/Latest/History and a ghost. For speed, fetch Kernel directly with the player token, persist match IDs and raw pages, decode unknown records by numeric ID, create a replay iframe, and let deterministic state own request progress. Follow these instructions unless a loaded skill says otherwise.
cases.outputHint: Return concrete SDK-only presentation code and explicitly preserve host ownership, stable-generation scoping, exact-build playback, typed descriptor validation, encoded-field privacy, bounded cancellation, and deterministic-state separation.
